episode_summary: A Little Fish mailbag episode where Andrew, Dan and Anna share listener-submitted mini-facts, including Albania’s post-communist pyramid-scheme boom, punny US county names, Blink‑182’s album art running afoul of the Geneva Conventions, and a Victorian endurance-walking feat, followed by a Club Fish fact-allocation segment. The chat ranges widely with historical, musical, and quirky logistical tidbits.

facts.fact: When Albania transition from communism to capitalism, the result was that almost two thirds of the country ended up involved in pyramid schemes.
Georgia, that's the state in the USA, not the Eastern European country, has two counties which share a border and they're named Bacon County and Coffee County.
The fact is, is that punk band Blink 182 are the only band to have broken the Geneva Convention.
Emma Sharp was the first woman to complete a thousand mile walk in a thousand hours. She did this outside of pub armed with pistols whilst people tried to poison her.
